source: J. Gresham Machen, New Testament Greek for Beginners (1923, public domain)

units.title: The Alphabet
units.description: Read and write the twenty-four letters of the Greek alphabet.

units.title: Breathings and Accents
units.description: Breathings, the three accents, and the rules that fix where an accent may stand.

units.title: Present Active Indicative
units.description: The present tense of λύω and the verb endings that show the subject.

units.title: The Second Declension
units.description: Masculine and neuter nouns in -ος and -ον; cases, word order and movable ν.

units.title: The First Declension
units.description: Feminine nouns in -α and -η.

units.title: The Article and Adjectives
units.description: The definite article, adjectives of the second and first declension, attributive and predicate positions.

units.title: Masculine First Declension; Prepositions
units.description: Nouns in -ης like προφήτης, and prepositions with the genitive, dative and accusative.

units.title: Enclitics, Personal Pronouns, εἰμί
units.description: Enclitics and their accents, the personal pronouns, and the present of εἰμί.

units.title: Demonstratives and αὐτός
units.description: The demonstratives οὗτος and ἐκεῖνος, and αὐτός meaning self and same.

units.title: Present Middle and Passive
units.description: The present middle and passive of λύω, ὑπό of the agent, the dative of means, deponent and compound verbs.

units.title: The Imperfect Active
units.description: The imperfect active indicative, the augment, and the imperfect of εἰμί.

units.title: Imperfect Middle and Passive
units.description: The imperfect middle and passive, a singular verb with a neuter plural subject, and the uses of καί and οὐδέ.

units.title: The Future
units.description: The future active and middle indicative, futures of stems ending in a consonant, and deponent futures.

units.title: The First Aorist
units.description: The first aorist active and middle indicative, and the constructions with πιστεύω.

units.title: The Second Aorist
units.description: The second aorist active and middle indicative.

units.title: The Aorist and Future Passive
units.description: The aorist and future passive indicative, second aorist passives, and deponent verbs with passive forms.

units.title: The Third Declension
units.description: Nouns of the third declension: ἐλπίς, νύξ, ἄρχων, and the neuters in -μα.

units.title: Present Participles
units.description: The present participles, active and middle-passive, and how participles are used.

units.title: Aorist Participles
units.description: The aorist participles, active and middle, and the negatives οὐ and μή.

units.title: The Aorist Passive Participle
units.description: The aorist passive participle and the genitive absolute.

units.title: The Subjunctive
units.description: The subjunctive mood: purpose with ἵνα, future conditions with ἐάν, and the hortatory subjunctive.

units.title: The Infinitive
units.description: The present and aorist infinitives, the articular infinitive, indirect discourse and proper names.

units.title: Contract Verbs
units.description: Verbs in -άω, -έω and -όω: the rules of contraction and the lengthened vowel of the other tenses.

units.title: Liquid Verbs; Reflexive Pronouns
units.description: The future and first aorist of liquid verbs, the future of εἰμί, and the reflexive pronouns.

units.title: More Third-Declension Nouns; Adjectives in -ης
units.description: Third-declension nouns like χάρις, πόλις, γένος, βασιλεύς and πατήρ, and adjectives in -ης, -ες.
